plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 33 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Wes1611, Hwy 16, Sam Ross East FSR, Francois Lake Rd.
Park: 54.00515, -125.23594, pull off on Francois Lake Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.4 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 197 m, about 47 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2016 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-4, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
R6F-deer-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-4: about 3,453 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.38 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.4 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
